headline: Fed Chair Warsh speaks at noon ET today, then retail sales and Nvidia earnings Tuesday and FOMC minutes Wednesday, with a hawkish Fed and ~5% 10-year yields the key risk.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield is reported near 5.15% after hotter inflation data, and some traders price a possible half-point December hike.
fed: The Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% on Oct 28 (10-2 vote); Williams speaks today at 9:05 AM ET, Warsh at noon ET, and FOMC minutes come Wednesday at 2 PM ET.
oil: Brent settled about $95.84 and WTI about $88.56 on Friday, after a second weekly loss on supply-surplus worries, with US-Iran tensions still keeping a bid under prices.
geo: US-Iran tensions persist (Trump said the US doesn't need a deal with Iran); Anthropic is expected to begin Nasdaq trading Thursday.

events.name: Final UMich sentiment / monthly options expiry
